title: The Dragon Strength Pill
summary: Xiao Yan and Han Xian, chief of the Medicine Gang and a fourth-tier alchemist, hold their pill-refining match before a crowd. Elder Hao sets the Fifth-Tier Dragon Strength Pill, with two sets of herbs each, and Han Xian uses the Illusionary Golden Flame, taken from the shell of a Rank Seven Illusionary Fire Scorpion Dragon Beast. He hands in a half-done pill, betting that Xiao Yan will fail. Xiao Yan's cheap cauldron explodes, but he comes out of the smoke with a finished Dragon Strength Pill. Elder Hao declares him the winner, so Rock Gate takes over the Medicine Gang's five busiest trading spots. Half a month later Han Yue and Lin Xiu Ya set out on a mission, and Xiao Yan goes into the mountains with Yao Lao. There he starts the Three Thousand Lightning Movement by drawing the wind-lightning strength out of its scroll and refining it with the Green Lotus Core Flame.
events: Han Xian and Xiao Yan take the stage; Xiao Yan stakes three prescriptions against the Medicine Gang's five trading spots.
Elder Hao sets the Fifth-Tier Dragon Strength Pill with two tries each.
Han Xian shows the Illusionary Golden Flame.
Han Xian hands in a half-done pill.
Xiao Yan's cauldron explodes, but his pill is finished; Elder Hao rules him the winner.
First Elder Su Qian watches; an elder admits he lost his bet on the result.
Han Yue and Lin Xiu Ya set off on a mission.
In the mountains Xiao Yan begins refining the wind-lightning strength of the Three Thousand Lightning Movement.
introduced: Rank Seven Illusionary Fire Scorpion Dragon Beast
cultivation: Han Xian is a fourth-tier alchemist. Xiao Yan refines a Fifth-Tier Pill. An alchemist who can do that is called 'almost as valuable as a Dou Wang if not a Dou Huang'.
